rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP LXXV If one shall profit by his Knowledge
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A numbered question concerns benefit from an individual's acquired specialist knowledge.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Starts original PDF463 printed429 below prior LXXIV horizontal divider.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Chymistry Chyrurgery or if he be perfect
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Chemistry, surgery and other disciplines are examples of specialism or competence.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: No independently measured expertise or clinical performance provided.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: querent ascendant his Lord and Moon
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The questioner is signified by first house, its ruler and Moon.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Distinct from the ninth for the skill under consideration.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: ninth house its Planet and Lord for Science
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Science or knowledge is represented by ninth house and its lord and occupant.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: The source separates house, ruler and planet occupancy.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord ninth fortunate, Oriental or Occidental
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source considers ninth lord strength, orientation and angular status.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Not a single unconditional ninth-lord rule.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: angle or succedent versus cadent
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Angular/succedent or cadent placement are separately considered.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: No numerical skill score supplied.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord ninth behold Lord ascendant sextile or trine
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A favorable aspect between ninth and first lord is supportive.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Original uses sextile OR trine, not arbitrary planetary interaction.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord ninth Fortune and aspect first
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A benefic ninth lord aspecting first is an alternative positive testimony.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Requires actual relation to questioner significator.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: man has good knowledge and reported true
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author predicts genuine knowledge and accurate reputation under favorable conditions.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: No externally verified claimant or knowledge outcome.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: will do good by knowledge
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly adds usefulness or profit from specialization.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Having skill and making financial use of it are distinct endpoints.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: more if reception
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Reception increases the favorable claim.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: A conditional modifier, not universally assumed.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: aspect square or opposition
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A square or opposition between significators changes the judgment.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: The source allows substantial knowledge but inadequate benefit.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: knows much but does no good thereby
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author allows high knowledge but failure to profit.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Distinct from knowing little or nothing.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: infortune afflicts first or ninth lord
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Adverse contact from a malefic is another negative premise.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Do not fuse with the hard aspect as always simultaneous.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: weary himself never perfect desired knowledge
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He says effort may be fruitless and mastery remain unattained.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Source conjecture, not actual professional outcomes.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Science Cunning or Wisdome in a man whether true
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: An unnumbered subsection separately asks if another person truly possesses claimed knowledge.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: The original heading begins at top PDF464, after end PDF463 knowledge-profit clause.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: printed PDF464 header 431, not 430
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The physical source image in the next scan has printed page numeral 431.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: PDF465 subsequently carries printed numeral 430, although source text flows normally from PDF464 to PDF465.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: give ascendant him of whom asked
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The ascendant is assigned to the person whose ability is queried.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Different from questioner as default first house in prior question.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: ninth house for science
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The ninth represents the field of knowledge.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: No named individual or measured competency.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Fortunes ninth or ninth Lord fortunate behold ascendant
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Benefics in ninth OR strong ninth lord aspecting first are positive testimony.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Preserve original disjunction and aspect to first.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: there is Science in that man
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author infers genuine learning under favorable conditions.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Not tested on independently assessed real expertise.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: infortunes ninth or ninth Lord unfortunate and not behold first
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A negative condition uses adverse ninth testimony with lack of first-lord aspect.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Both adverse ninth position and failure to behold first are material.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: no or little knowledge
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly draws a negative skill assessment.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Does not independently demonstrate incompetence.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon and Lord ninth apply fortunes
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Moon and ninth lord applying to benefics support actual knowledge.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Original needs both Moon and ninth lord relationship.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: knowledge in the man
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The claim is that the person knows the field.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: No observable skill scoring.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon and Lord ninth apply infortunes
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Malefic application gives negative knowledge testimony.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Distinct from no ninth-to-first aspect.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: contrary to knowledge
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author draws an unfavorable conclusion.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: No observed outcome.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: ninth and lord unfortunate nor behold ascendant
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source repeats combined adverse ninth and absent first aspect testimony.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: If this is about querent versus someone else, role selection changes.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: knowledge useless even if claimant has some
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source allows some knowledge without useful application.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Preserves economic usefulness versus competence distinction.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of many Persons absent or travelling in what Condition
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A new unnumbered subsection introduces multiple absentees whose circumstances are asked about.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Begins original PDF464, after the knowledge-authenticity rules.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: four or five or more travelling in a company
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The inquiry can cover a group of several people overseas or distant.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: The people are hypothetical; no identified genuine travellers.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: querent write all names in order
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly requires an ordered list of the absentees.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Participant enumeration sequence matters for the claimed algorithm.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon first application first listed man
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Moon first applying planet is used for first listed person.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: The ordering depends on the list; cannot infer real status.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: check position dignity aspects separation application
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author instructs evaluation of the planet dignity and contacts for condition.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Planetary context, separating and applying phases remain separate.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: health and welfare of first man
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author's projected result includes the first person's circumstances, health and safety.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: No independent real missing-person or clinical evidence.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon second application second named man
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A second lunar application gives second person.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Not an independently measured state.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: second person's state by fortune or affliction
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author infers a second person's circumstances from next planet.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Source statement continues across PDF464 to PDF465.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: how well / or ill being of that Planet
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The first PDF464 line ending regarding the second person's condition continues on PDF465 with favorable or unfavorable testimony.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: The physical scan order is correct even though printed folios read 431 then 430.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: successive Moon applications for later people
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author proposes following Moon applications to third, fourth and further absentees.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: This is a sequential allocation convention, not real observations.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: consider retrogradations directions combustions
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly includes motion, directions and combustion when classifying later persons.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Each is another source qualifier, not a verified person outcome.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: repeat Moon application sequence if more than seven
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He instructs repeating the cycle if the list exceeds seven persons.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Cycling introduces multiple possible interpretations rather than unique identification.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: also Man asking after many Women
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The same sequence is applied when a man asks about several women.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Historical gender framing; no case cohort.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To what part of Heaven Traveller had best direct Journey
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A separate unnumbered section considers which compass quarter someone should travel toward.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Still Chapter LXXV; some ideas recur from earlier general travel methods.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: to what part of World best for me to travel
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source describes an ideal-direction question.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: No independent comparison among possible destinations.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: locate where fortunate Planets placed, most fortified
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly favors quadrants containing strong benefics.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: This is broad source doctrine, not safe modern travel advice.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Fortune east quadrant travel eastward
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: East-quadrant benefic planets are associated with eastward travel.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Planet strength and favorable status assumed.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Fortune south quarter travel southward
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: South quadrant is linked to southerly travel.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: No map coordinate or distance given.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Fortune west quadrant travel westward
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: West quadrant is linked to westerly travel.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Independent of seasonal weather and route.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Fortune north quadrant travel northward
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: North quadrant is linked to northerly travel.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: No measured comparison.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: choose quarter with greatest number fortunes
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A plurality of strong benefics can dominate choice.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Does not specify a deterministic weighting for exact degrees or houses.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: avoid quarters where Infortunes posited
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source discourages choosing an adverse quadrant.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Unsafe to infer actual hazards from positions.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: include South Node among Infortunes
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly specifically adds the lunar south node as adverse.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Period symbolic source only.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: second and eighth Houses special care
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The text treats these two financial houses as separate outcomes.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: House choice changes depending on staying abroad versus return.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: adverse eighth gives little gain in country going to
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: An unfavorable occupant in eighth predicts little material success at destination.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Not a real trade or employment comparison.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: adverse second gives poor results after returning
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Malefic second occupancy is linked to financial difficulty back home.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Distinct destination-house role from eighth.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: good eighth for fortune in foreign destination
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source elects fortunate eighth for successful settlement abroad.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: An electional example, not an observed scenario.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: good second to live happily after return home
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Favorable second-house condition is contrasted for happy circumstances after returning.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Sentence spans physical PDF465–466.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: fortunate Planet / is in the second
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The final original choice of favorable second-house placement continues onto PDF466.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Underlying scan text continuous despite swapped prior printed numbers.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: beware Cauda in second on return or eighth when setting forth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly warns about lunar south node in second for return and eighth for departure.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Two stages and houses; no independent financial outcome or travel hazard.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP LXXVI If an idle covetous Priest ... good Parsonage
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A new numbered chapter concerns a cleric seeking an ecclesiastical benefice.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: New chapter begins after horizontal divider on original PDF466, printed432.

rules.short_source_anchor_not_diplomatic: whether he shall obtain Parsonage
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The subject changes from general science, absentee and direction rules to an appointment question.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Heading only, no following LXXVI claims admitted into LXXV.
